properties.description:
Criterion 3 of the 2026-09-11 tool sweep, and the increment that found a shipped feature had never run.

**THE CLASS.** `unclaimed_findings` called with no arguments answered `failed to deserialize parameters: missing field ` + "`change_event_ids`" + `` — naming neither the tool nor the obligation. Filed as a one-off; it is not. **139 of 180 served tools declare at least one required parameter, across 230 required parameters**, and every one answered in that shape, because the refusal is produced by the deserialiser BEFORE any handler runs. One interception, in the one place they all pass through: the refusal now names the tool, the field, and quotes the schema's own description of it. It lists EVERY required field too, which closes the separate complaint that validation teaches one field per round trip — serde reports only the first.

⭐ **AND THE BRANCH IT WAS MODELLED ON HAD NEVER FIRED.** `call_tool` has intercepted `unknown field` refusals since v0.51.0 to add a reconnect sentence for a stale client. rmcp 3 returns a deserialisation failure as `Ok(CallToolResponse::Complete)` with `is_error: true`, **not** as `Err`, so the `Err` arm matched nothing on the wire. Nothing caught it because the test calls `stale_client_hint` as a PURE FUNCTION and has passed every day since it was written: it proves the sentence and says nothing about whether a caller receives it. A unit test of a helper standing in for a test of the wiring, green throughout, invisible to all 217 suites.

**THE LESSON, and it is why the pin is a wire-level gate.** `tools/refusal_speaks.py` asks a real server. Run against the UNFIXED binary it reported **140 failures — 139 tools plus the dead branch** — and zero against the fixed one. The Rust tests are kept for the sentence, with a header saying in as many words that they are not sufficient.

**WHAT IT SURFACED AND DID NOT FIX.** Quoting the schema only helps when the schema has something to say: **76 of 230 required parameters (33%), across 68 tools, publish no description at all** — 21 of them a constructor's own `id`, ~55 not. The refusal says so out loud rather than inventing a sentence. Measured, recorded, not started.
properties.name: A missing argument names the tool and what it wants — and the interception beside it had been dead since v0.51.0
